subject: storytime
title: Mercy Watson words
about: Mercy is a pig who lives like a pampered daughter with Mr. and Mrs. Watson, and when she squeezes into their bed one night the floor starts to give way and the whole street ends up joining the rescue. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read a chapter together each night, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Kate DiCamillo
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A toast-loving pig, a sagging bedroom floor and a neighborhood that comes running.

cards.note: capital M, it is her name; er says er; c says s before y and y says ee: Mer-see
capital W, the family name; a says o after w and the o says u: Wot-sun
oa says long o; s-t at the end
f-l blend; oor says or here, like in door: flor
c-r blend; ck is one sound
tt is one t; two parts: but + ter; er says er
ar says ar, like in car
t-r blend; ck is one sound
all regular; l-p at the end
kn says n, the k is silent; ck is one sound: nock
two parts: sis + ters; er says er; the last s says z
capital B, it is her name; the a says its name and y says ee: Bay-bee
two parts: res + cue; ue says yoo, like in cue
ow says ou, like in cow
